title.en: What Does Multilingual LLM Output Resemble?
title.ja: 多言語LLMの出力は何に似ているのか

summary.en: A short note on translationese in multilingual LLM generation, and a question that may be more useful than asking whether a model "thinks in English."
summary.ja: 多言語LLMの直接生成に現れるtranslationeseと、「英語で考えているか」より 検証しやすそうな問いについての短いメモ。

paper.title: An Investigation of Translationese in the Generations of Multilingual Large Language Models

summary.en: A small kickoff for this new space — and a first test of how I want to keep and share research notes.
summary.ja: 研究メモを残し、共有するための新しい場所としてNotesを始めます。

title.en: Does Romanization Really Help Multilingual Transfer?
title.ja: Romanizationは言語間転移を本当に助けるのか

summary.en: A short note on romanized multilingual pretraining, why it improves cross-script transfer, and why the mechanism may be more complicated than lexical overlap alone.
summary.ja: Romanizationをpretrainingから使うと異なる文字体系間の言語間転移が強くなるという結果と、 その理由を語彙の重なりだけでは説明しきれないのでは、という短いメモ。

paper.title: One Form to Transfer Them All: Pretraining Multilingual Language Models Beyond Native Orthography
paper.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
